components.name: Shared Huddle Header
components.description: Home-linked brand island on the left, theme control and route actions on the right.
components.css: .huddle-brand-theme-header { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:60px; } .huddle-brand-theme-header__brand { margin-right:auto; } .huddle-brand-theme-header__theme, .huddle-brand-theme-header__trailing { flex:0 0 auto; }

components.name: Warm Task Panel
components.description: A framed task surface with warm fill, strong boundary, and offset structural lift.
components.html:
CURRENT HANDOFF

components.name: Live Media Frame
components.description: Dark, cut-corner media frame that preserves full camera and screen content.
components.css: .cyber-frame { padding:1.5px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--magenta), var(--cyan)); } .cyber-clip { clip-path:polygon(16px 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 16px),calc(100% - 16px) 100%,0 100%,0 16px); } video { object-fit:contain; }

narrative.overview: Huddle moves a conversation into shared work. Warm editorial route shells make the current handoff readable, while the active call keeps a deliberately dark media field so faces and shared displays stay legible. The system is scoped by surface: public, account, entry, archive, error, and 404 routes use Signal Handoff; the root dot-grid is only a future/unscoped fallback.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream/chocolate themes with scoped route tokens.
Purple authority, yellow focus/active/recoverable state, red recording/stop/failure.
Archivo Black, Archivo, and IBM Plex Mono with strict semantic roles.
Flat framed panels and offset structural shadows.
Media-first call geometry with protected consent and Remote Control state.

rules.name: The One Signal per Moment Rule
rules.body: Purple answers authority, yellow answers active or recoverable state, and red answers recording, stopping, or failure.

rules.name: The Scoped World Rule
rules.body: Route shells own their visual world explicitly; the root dark baseline is only a fallback.

rules.name: The Dark Media Rule
rules.body: The media well stays dark in both themes so live content remains legible.

rules.name: The Brand-left Rule
rules.body: Huddle branding stays left and actions stay right at every breakpoint.

rules.name: The Media Owns the Stage Rule
rules.body: Chrome protects the important shared content rather than covering it.

rules.name: The Structural First Rule
rules.body: Use tone, border, and placement before adding shadow.

rules.name: The Cut Means Live Rule
rules.body: Cut corners belong to live media and capture surfaces, not ordinary forms.

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: Monospace is data or state, not decoration.

dos: Use the scoped warm tokens on audited route shells.
Keep media unobscured and use object-contain for joined media.
Preserve consent, admission, Direct Rejoin, Recording, Drive, and attended Remote Control behavior.
Provide visible focus and reduced-motion fallbacks.
donts: Do not describe the audited application as dark-only.
Do not migrate the dark media field into a light video surface.
Do not turn every section into a repeated rounded-card grid.
Do not use monospace as a costume or compress recovery copy into cryptic HUD language.
